_comment: HP07: Co-Curricular | Competency | Demonstrated — OSIL, real-world context
badge_description: Recognizes NJIT students who have demonstrated community engagement competency in real-world service contexts. Students apply knowledge, skills, and abilities across multiple service projects.
intended_audience: NJIT students engaged in community service
earning_criteria_text: Students must complete a verified community project and receive a supervisor evaluation. The faculty advisor assesses the student's demonstrated competency using a standardized rubric. Evidence must come from real-world service contexts.
